# Not evaluated: VarSeak (VHL's PP3 and BP4: only the SpliceAI half is applied; the specification allows SpliceAI alone where VarSeak cannot take the variant), PhyloP (VHL's BP7), RNA evidence and PVS1 (PALB2). added: # E20 C13: the VCEP specifications' splicing rules applied to this study's data (src/evid_suppl_c13.py), from data/evidence/vcep/vcep_rules.json; BP7 as each specification defines it (E20b).

# Score column: spliceai_walker (published basis: SpliceAI 1.3.1, distance 4,999, unmasked, the largest of the four deltas), for every rule. PALB2's specification names the SVI's thresholds (Walker et al. 2023); VHL's states no setting. ENIGMA's (BRCA1, BRCA2) states its setting in its Appendix J, not in the criterion's text (E20b; Appendices_V1.2_2024-11-18.docx, recorded in data/evidence/vcep/raw/manifest.json): the largest of the four deltas, 'unmasked' scores, Max Distance 10 000; SpliceAI is cited by its paper (Jaganathan et al. 2019), with no version, online tool or annotation named. Neither SpliceAI column of this study has that distance (spliceai_walker 4,999; spliceai 50), so no row is computed on another column. The rule's cut point is applied to the column as it stands.

# BP7, as each specification defines it, counted as c6_bp4_bp7.csv counts (the SGE labels, the signed offset read from the c. notation, spliceai_walker). ENIGMA: donor +7 and beyond, acceptor -21 and beyond, with BP4 (SpliceAI <= 0.1); the same definition as c6's condition (a), and equal to it cell for cell. PALB2: donor +8 and beyond, acceptor -22 and beyond (+7 and -21 not included); (i) the criterion's text, no prediction condition; (ii) with BP4 (SpliceAI <= 0.1), as the instructions to use allow ('May also apply BP4 to achieve Likely Benign'). VHL: no position stated, so this study's 3-10, 11-50 and 3-50 nt, with BP4's SpliceAI half (<= 0.1) and PhyloP <= 0.2; PhyloP is the analysis set's phylop: UCSC phyloP100way, hg38 (docs/column-provenance.md); the specification names no version; variants without it are not counted (0 in 3-50 nt). The +/-1-2 nt positions are outside this study's PP3 and BP4 bands and are not counted.

# Not evaluated: VarSeak (VHL's PP3, BP4 and BP7: only the SpliceAI half is applied; the specification allows SpliceAI alone where VarSeak cannot take the variant), RNA evidence and PVS1 (PALB2). A gene with no labelled variant in a band or at the positions: 'no labelled variants at this distance in this gene's assay'.
